articles.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
articles.snippet: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

articles.title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
articles.snippet: The committee that needs to advance President Donald Trump's nominees responded quickly to set his SEC picks for review next week.

articles.title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward says expansion outside crypto trading helps cushion revenue decline
articles.snippet: While earnings and the company’s newly introduced financial performance measure remained below year-earlier levels, there are signs of improvement from the second quarter.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.
